title.en: Civil Services (Preliminary) Examination: General Studies Paper II
title.hi: सिविल सेवा (प्रारंभिक) परीक्षा : सामान्य अध्ययन प्रश्नपत्र II

qualifying.basis: Paper-II is a qualifying paper with minimum qualifying marks fixed at 33% (Section II A Note (ii), PDF p.26; Section III Part A Note 1, PDF p.32).

instructions.en: General Studies Paper II is an objective paper of two hours for 200 marks. It is qualifying: a candidate needs at least 33% in it, and its marks do not count towards the cut-off. Every question has four answer options. A wrong answer costs one-third (0.33) of the marks for that question, more than one answer counts as a wrong answer, and a blank costs nothing. Questions are set in Hindi and English. Calculators are not allowed.
instructions.hi: सामान्य अध्ययन प्रश्नपत्र II दो घंटे का 200 अंकों का वस्तुनिष्ठ प्रश्नपत्र है। यह क्वालीफ़ाइंग है: इसमें कम से कम 33% अंक चाहिए, और इसके अंक कट-ऑफ़ में नहीं जुड़ते। हर प्रश्न के चार उत्तर विकल्प होते हैं। गलत उत्तर पर उस प्रश्न के अंकों का एक-तिहाई (0.33) काटा जाता है, एक से अधिक उत्तर देने को गलत उत्तर माना जाता है, और खाली छोड़े गए प्रश्न पर कोई अंक नहीं कटता। प्रश्न हिंदी और अंग्रेज़ी दोनों में होते हैं। कैलकुलेटर की अनुमति नहीं है।

open_questions.question: The Civil Services Examination, 2027 notice is not published yet (checked 2026-10-30). This is the latest official pattern; re-verify and version it as upsc-cse-2027 when UPSC notifies it.

The UPSC Annual Calendar 2027 (https://www.upsc.gov.in/sites/default/files/Calendar-Year-2027-Engl-200526.pdf) could not be opened from this environment (HTTP 403), so the 2027 notification and Prelims dates are not recorded.

The number of questions in each paper and the marks per question are not stated in the notice. They are printed on the question booklets, which UPSC publishes on its exam page; those pages could not be opened from this environment (HTTP 403), so question_count stays null.
Session timings (forenoon and afternoon) are not stated in the notice; they appear on the e-Admit Card. shift_timings stays null.
The notice says the papers are set in Hindi and English but does not say which version prevails when they differ.
The paper has no numeric-entry questions, so the notice states no way of typing numbers.
The notice does not state the number of questions in this section (see the open question on question_count).
The notice does not state the marks for each question; the penalty for a wrong answer is one-third (0.33) of those marks (Appendix I Section I Note II, PDF p.25).
